content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family and attached homes to individual buyers through its own sales centers, with mortgage services, like NVR."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to individual buyers, with in-house mortgage and title services, matching NVR's model."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Sells finished lots to homebuilders as a B2B land developer, not building and selling homes to individual buyers."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to individual buyers with affiliated mortgage financing, closely matching NVR."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family and attached homes directly to individual buyers, with mortgage and title subsidiaries, like NVR."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes to individual buyers with in-house mortgage and title services supporting sales, like NVR."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Underwrites title and property-casualty insurance for many business and individual customers; it does not build or sell homes."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Sells life insurance, runs cemeteries and mortuaries alongside mortgages; homebuilding is absent from its business."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family and attached homes to individual buyers with affiliated mortgage and title services, like NVR."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Diversified Florida land company with hotels, clubs, timber and leasing; its home sales are a minor part of a different business."}]}
